data.retirementBeneficiary: 北京市盈科律师事务所98家分所 98 branches of Yingke Law Firm.
data.retirementDetails: 经BSI第三方核查，北京市盈科律师事务所除北京、上海、广州、成都、深圳之外，在中国境内的其余98家律师事务所分所2022年度温室气体排放量为6834.66tCO2e。基于保守性原则，将各分所温室气体排放量向上取整，计算获得碳中和所需的碳抵消数量为6887tCO2e。北京市盈科律师事务所98家分所自愿购买并注销来自蓝口水电项目（VCS注册号：371）的6887 t自愿减排量，以达成北京市盈科律师事务所98家分所2022年度基于PAS 2060：2014标准的碳中和。After verified by BSI, it is found out that there were 98 branches of Yingke Law Firm in total across China excluding Beijing, Shanghai, Guangzhou, Chengdu and Shenzhen in 2022, and that the total greenhouse gas emission of the 98 branches in the year was 6,834.66 tCO2e. Based on the conservative principle and calculation by means of rounding up the GHG emission of each branch, the total carbon offset required to achieve carbon neutrality of the 98 branches in the year was 6,887 tCO2e. Therefore, the 98 branches voluntarily purchased and wrote off a total VCUs of 6,887 metric tons from Lankou Hydro Power Project (VCS ID: 371) to achieve their own carbon neutrality according to the PAS 2060: 2014 standard for the year of 2022.
